_comment: When each baseline file was captured from the live project. scripts/check-baseline-age.mjs and db-local-bootstrap read this to surface staleness — a baseline nobody has refreshed is a false sense of security. db-baseline-refresh.mjs updates schema; a non-public recapture (scripts/db-nonpublic-capture.sql) updates non_public.

schema.refresh: npm run db:baseline:refresh (non-interactive when the Supabase link has stored credentials; falls back to asking for your terminal)

non_public.refresh: run scripts/db-nonpublic-capture.sql read-only against the live project, rewrite non-public.sql to match
